[[Ajamduk's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mehtani Keys]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +8
:[[Earth damage|Earth Dmg]]: 9-15 (Requires 5 [[Earth Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Energy +3 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +20
